grok-imagine-video.pricingTier: xAI public Imagine API video pricing
grok-imagine-video.pricingNotes: xAI Imagine video estimates use published per-second rates, with resolution-specific multipliers normalized by AutoShow. Input image/reference image charges are included when selected, and input video charges are included when input-video duration is known. Discounts, enterprise pricing, taxes, and provider credits are ignored unless provider usage is returned.

gen4.5.pricingNotes: Runway Gen-4.5 is priced at 12 credits per second, represented as $0.12/s using the API credit reference. Plan credits, discounts, enterprise pricing, taxes, and provider credits are ignored.

ltx-2-3-fast.pricingNotes: Text-to-video and image-to-video are priced at $0.06/s for 1920x1080 or 1080x1920, with 2560x1440/1440x2560 at 2x and 3840x2160/2160x3840 at 4x. Supports first-to-last-frame interpolation. Discounts, enterprise pricing, taxes, and provider credits are ignored.

ltx-2-3-pro.description: LTX-2.3 Pro video generation, interpolation, and extension model
ltx-2-3-pro.pricingNotes: Text-to-video and image-to-video are priced at $0.08/s for 1920x1080 or 1080x1920, with 2560x1440/1440x2560 at 2x and 3840x2160/2160x3840 at 4x. Extension is estimated at $0.10/s and LTX may bill context frames. Discounts, enterprise pricing, taxes, and provider credits are ignored.

alibaba/happyhorse-1.0.description: Alibaba Happy Horse 1.0 text-to-video and image-to-video model
alibaba/happyhorse-1.0.pricingNotes: Replicate Happy Horse estimates use per-second output pricing. The CLI sends an explicit 720p default resolution for provider-default selection.

bytedance/seedance-2.0.description: ByteDance Seedance 2.0 multimodal video generation model
bytedance/seedance-2.0.pricingNotes: Seedance estimates use non-video rates for text, image, and audio/reference-image inputs, and video-input rates when input/reference videos are present. Intelligent duration (-1) is estimated as 5 seconds before generation.

bytedance/seedance-2.0-fast.description: ByteDance Seedance 2.0 Fast multimodal video generation model
bytedance/seedance-2.0-fast.pricingNotes: Seedance Fast estimates use non-video rates for text, image, and audio/reference-image inputs, and video-input rates when input/reference videos are present. 1080p is not supported. Intelligent duration (-1) is estimated as 5 seconds before generation.

wan-video/wan-2.7-t2v.pricingNotes: Wan 2.7 T2V estimates use flat per-second output pricing. The CLI sends an explicit 720p default resolution for provider-default selection.

ray-3.2.description: Luma Ray 3.2 text-to-video and image-to-video model
ray-3.2.pricingTier: Luma Agents pay-as-you-go video generation pricing
ray-3.2.pricingNotes: Ray 3.2 standard dynamic range video generation is priced per clip by resolution and duration: 360p $0.06/$0.18, 540p $0.15/$0.45, 720p $0.30/$0.90, 1080p $1.20/$3.60 for 5s/10s. HDR, EXR, edit, and reframe tiers are not modeled here. Provisioned Throughput discounts, taxes, and provider credits are ignored.
